summary: An eight-structure seed/fail batch for images 01, 02, 10, and 13 was hash-bound for exact MatRIS, AQCat25, and VASP force comparison; the dual-model request and all VASP diagnostic-static preflights passed without submission.

payload.objective: Obtain separate authorization for the eight-structure MZ73 MatRIS/AQCat25 fixed prediction batch, review its returned hashes, then request a separate bounded VASP label decision.
current_evidence: The selected batch contains seed/fail pairs for images 01, 02, 10, and 13, covering the H50 inter-image blocker and both sides of the O-H transition-region collapse.

The step-22 immediate last-valid state was overwritten; the hash-bound step-0 seed is explicitly retained only as the last persisted proven-valid reference, not mislabeled as the immediate last-valid point.
The eight structures are unique within the batch and have zero exact or rounded-geometry overlap with the frozen held-out set.
The MatRIS/AQCat25 exact prediction request passed its validator and binds the frozen checkpoint hashes.
All eight VASP static-force inputs passed diagnostic_static preflight with NSW=0, SIGMA=0.20 eV, 5x5x1 k mesh, and 32 ranks.
No GPU or VASP job was submitted and no model error or fine-tuning trigger is established yet.
payload.one_executable_step: After separate explicit authorization, run exactly one hash-bound eight-structure MatRIS/AQCat25 fixed prediction batch on MZ73; do not submit VASP until the prediction set returns to work and is reviewed.
payload.submission_boundary: No GPU, VASP, fine-tuning, path rerun, Dimer, TS, or barrier submission is authorized by preparation alone.
done_when: The exact dual-model prediction set returns with matching structure and checkpoint hashes.
The returned predictions are reviewed and the same eight VASP inputs receive a separate bounded execution decision.
